name: produce-and-audit
description: Research a subject, produce an artifact, then audit it against a read-only QC gate. Domain-neutral: the thing produced can be a document, a config, a plan or a report.

subject.help: What to produce. A sentence is enough; the triage step decides how much work it warrants.

artifact_kind.help: What form the output should take — document, config, plan, report.

acceptance.help: What 'good' means here. Left empty, the audit judges against the subject alone.

steering_examples.description: Produce a one-page migration plan for moving our cron jobs to the new scheduler. Acceptance: names every job, flags the two that share state.
The audit found three Major findings — re-run the produce step with them as constraints rather than patching the artifact.

config.prompt:
Classify how much work this subject warrants.

tier=light: a known, bounded thing — write it directly.
tier=standard: needs a look around first.
tier=deep: unfamiliar or contested; needs a real sweep before writing.

Return JSON: {"tier": "light|standard|deep", "why": "one line"}.

Subject:
{{inputs.subject}}

expr.note: Triaged light — writing directly from the subject.

config.prompt:
Audit the artifact below. READ-ONLY: report findings, change nothing — an auditor that edits is no longer an independent check, and the next reviewer cannot tell what was found from what was fixed.

Judge against the acceptance criteria when given; against the subject otherwise. Be specific about location — 'the third paragraph' is actionable, 'the tone' is not.

Return JSON: {"findings": [Finding], "verdict": "pass|revise"}.
A Finding is {severity: Critical|Major|Minor|Nit, location, problem, why, recommended_fix, status: Open}.

Severity means: Critical = wrong or unusable as delivered. Major = a reader would be misled or blocked. Minor = a real flaw that does not block. Nit = preference.

Subject:
{{inputs.subject}}

Acceptance criteria:
{{inputs.acceptance}}

Artifact:
{{nodes.produce.output}}
The audit found issues worth your decision. Approve to accept the artifact as-is, or deny and re-run `produce` with the findings as constraints.
